data.narrative: The Module 02 reflection evaluates the sequential GitHub Actions pipeline, including PR validation, fail-fast gates, SHA traceability, image-size enforcement, and secret-scoped publication. YAML parsing, lint, Nest build, focused mocked tests, and git diff checking passed locally; Docker daemon access was denied and PostgreSQL reachability returned False, so image, registry, and live DB/HTTP checks remain NOT EXECUTED.

dimension_scores.observation: The pipeline requirements were expressed as specific triggers, ordered gates, timeout/cache settings, and publication conditions.
dimension_scores.evidence: The root workflow runs for pull requests and pushes to main, uses a lockfile-keyed npm cache, and gates image publication on successful main pushes.

dimension_scores.observation: The reflection considers fail-fast behavior, clean-CI database assumptions, image bloat, tag traceability, and secret exposure.
dimension_scores.evidence: The CI fix artifact records the workflow safeguards and identifies the pre-seeded Alice/Bob integration-test assumption as a remaining clean-CI gap.

dimension_scores.observation: The fix was scoped to the workflow gates and trigger after confirming the existing ignore rules already exclude environment and credential files.
dimension_scores.evidence: The workflow changes add PR validation and explicit success conditions without unnecessary changes to package.json or prisma/.

dimension_scores.observation: Claims are calibrated to the local evidence and unavailable services are marked NOT EXECUTED.
dimension_scores.evidence: Docker returned a named-pipe permission error and PostgreSQL port 5432 returned False; neither is presented as a successful live check.

dimension_scores.observation: The final pipeline and reflection provide actionable release gates and a reproducible local verification record.
dimension_scores.evidence: YAML parse, lint, build, 22 mocked tests, and git diff checks passed; remaining branch-protection, DB-fixture, Docker, and hosted-run checks are stated explicitly.

strengths: Uses sequential quality gates and explicit success conditions before image build and publication.
Keeps image tags tied to the commit SHA and enforces a 512 MiB size threshold.
Separates local mocked verification from unavailable Docker, registry, and database-backed evidence.
data.recommendation: Require the PR workflow through branch protection, replace pre-seeded integration-test accounts with isolated test-owned fixtures, and run Docker image, health, size, and registry checks in a GitHub-hosted environment before treating the pipeline as production-verified.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Explained how failed lint, build, test, or diff stages must stop Docker build and publication.
Connected commit-SHA tags and the 512 MiB image threshold to release traceability and bounded image size.
Recorded passing local checks while marking Docker and PostgreSQL/HTTP checks NOT EXECUTED due to observed access failures.

teaching_approaches.detail: Mapped lint, build, mocked tests, and diff validation to the later image and publication gates.
Compared each local command result with the live service checks it cannot establish.

public_evidence.artifact: Production Readiness Module 02 CI fix and reflection
public_evidence.student_action: Hardened sequential workflow gates and documented reproducible local validation and remaining environment limits.
public_evidence.technical_detail: The workflow validates pull requests to main, tags images with the commit SHA, checks the 512 MiB threshold, and scopes registry publication to successful main pushes.
public_evidence.proof: YAML parsing, lint, Nest build, two mocked Jest suites (22 tests), and git diff --check passed; Docker server access was denied and PostgreSQL port 5432 returned False.
public_evidence.ability: Applies release controls and reports verification limits accurately.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows how sequential automation, traceable artifacts, and explicit evidence boundaries support safer releases.
